name: Downloady
summary: Download the video in front of you, with text
description: Paste a link, or let Downloady pick up the page open in Safari or a Chromium browser, choose the quality, the video container and the audio format, and download it with yt-dlp. It can write the site's subtitles beside the video, or transcribe it on this Mac on macOS 26. Downloads and transcripts run in the background, in a queue you can watch from the notch.
